_comment: Comments-column entries (one line per income-statement line, year-over-year) and executive-summary bullets drafted from the archived releases and the owner-supplied call transcripts; each entry cites its source. Reviewed by the owner before publishing.

total_revenue.en: Up 12% USD (11% constant currency) to $14.9bn: Cloud +28%, led by Cloud Infrastructure +55%, while Software slipped 1%; currency added 1 point.
total_revenue.es: Creció 12% en USD (11% cc) a US$14.9 mil millones: Nube +28%, con Infraestructura +55%; Software bajó 1%; el tipo de cambio aportó 1 punto.
total_revenue.src: release p.1 narrative and bullets; income statement footnote 1

cloud.en: Cloud (IaaS+SaaS) +28% to $7.2bn: IaaS +55% to $3.3bn, SaaS +11%. Catz: OCI consumption up 57%, demand "continues to dramatically outstrip supply".
cloud.es: Nube (IaaS+SaaS) +28% a US$7.2 mil millones: IaaS +55% a US$3.3 mil millones, SaaS +11%. Catz: consumo OCI +57% y la demanda sigue rebasando por mucho la oferta.

software.en: Down 1% USD (2% cc) to $5.7bn: software license fell 12% while software support rose 1%; no further driver given by management.
software.es: Bajó 1% en USD (2% cc) a US$5.7 mil millones: licencias -12%, soporte +1%; la administración no da más explicación.
software.src: release p.1 narrative; REVENUES BY OFFERINGS table

hardware.en: Up 2% USD (1% cc) to $670m, the first increase after four quarters of declines; no driver given by management.
hardware.es: Subió 2% en USD (1% cc) a US$670 millones, primera alza tras cuatro trimestres a la baja; la administración no da una explicación.
hardware.src: release income statement; REVENUES BY OFFERINGS growth table

services.en: Up 7% USD (5% cc) to $1.35bn, reversing the FY25 declines; no driver given by management.
services.es: Subió 7% en USD (5% cc) a US$1,349 millones, revirtiendo las caídas del AF25; la administración no da una explicación.
services.src: release income statement; REVENUES BY OFFERINGS growth table

cloud_and_software_cost.en: Up 39% to $3.6bn versus revenue +12%, reflecting the datacenter build-out: depreciation rose to $1.35bn from $804m; cost ratio 24% of revenue vs 19%.
cloud_and_software_cost.es: Subió 39% a US$3.6 mil millones frente a ingresos +12%, por la expansión de centros de datos: depreciación US$1,351 millones vs US$804 millones; 24% de ingresos vs 19%.

hardware_cost.en: Up 10% to $178m against hardware revenue +2%; no driver given by management.
hardware_cost.es: Subió 10% a US$178 millones frente a ingresos de hardware +2%; la administración no da una explicación.

services_cost.en: Down 4% to $1.1bn while services revenue rose 7%; no driver given by management.
services_cost.es: Bajó 4% a US$1,099 millones mientras los ingresos por servicios subieron 7%; la administración no da una explicación.

sales_and_marketing.en: Up 1% (flat cc) to $2.06bn, easing to 14% of revenue from 15%; no driver given by management.
sales_and_marketing.es: Subió 1% (plano a tipo de cambio constante) a US$2,063 millones; baja a 14% de ingresos desde 15%; la administración no da una explicación.

research_and_development.en: Up 8% to $2.49bn, steady at 17% of revenue; includes $647m stock-based compensation vs $569m; no further driver given.
research_and_development.es: Subió 8% a US$2,491 millones, estable en 17% de ingresos; incluye US$647 millones de compensación accionaria vs US$569 millones; sin más explicación.
research_and_development.src: release income statement; non-GAAP reconciliation footnote 3

general_and_administrative.en: Up 5% (4% cc) to $376m, about 2% of revenue; no driver given by management.
general_and_administrative.es: Subió 5% (4% cc) a US$376 millones, cerca de 2% de ingresos; la administración no da una explicación.

amortization_of_intangibles.en: Down 33% to $420m as acquired intangibles run off; the release schedules $1,219m for the rest of FY26 and $672m for FY27.
amortization_of_intangibles.es: Bajó 33% a US$420 millones conforme se agotan los intangibles adquiridos; el reporte programa US$1,219 millones para el resto del AF26 y US$672 millones en AF27.
amortization_of_intangibles.src: release income statement; non-GAAP reconciliation footnote 4

restructuring_and_other.en: Restructuring jumped to $402m from $73m (+448%) plus $13m acquisition-related; defined as "employee severance and other exit costs"; excluded from non-GAAP.
restructuring_and_other.es: Reestructuración saltó a US$402 millones desde US$73 millones (+448%), más US$13 millones por adquisiciones; son indemnizaciones y costos de salida; se excluye del No-GAAP.

operating_income.en: GAAP +7% to $4.3bn (margin 29% vs 30%); non-GAAP +9% to $6.2bn (7% cc). Currency added 3 points; Catz expects mid-teens growth in FY26.
operating_income.es: GAAP +7% a US$4.3 mil millones (margen 29% vs 30%); No-GAAP +9% a US$6.2 (7% cc). Tipo de cambio +3 puntos; Catz prevé crecimiento mid-teens en AF26.
operating_income.src: release p.1 narrative; footnote 1; transcript p.3 (Catz)

interest_expense.en: Up 10% to $923m as borrowings rose: total debt $91.3bn vs $84.5bn a year earlier, funding the datacenter build; no other driver given.
interest_expense.es: Subió 10% a US$923 millones por mayor deuda: US$91.3 mil millones vs US$84.5 mil millones un año antes, para financiar centros de datos; sin más explicación.

nonoperating_income_net.en: Rose to $73m from $20m (+250%); small line, no driver given by management.
nonoperating_income_net.es: Subió a US$73 millones desde US$20 millones (+250%); partida menor, la administración no da una explicación.

tax_provision.en: Up 108% to $500m; GAAP rate 14.6% vs 7.6% because of a $958m net charge from the One Big Beautiful Bill Act (deferred-tax remeasurement), excluded from non-GAAP.
tax_provision.es: Subió 108% a US$500 millones; tasa GAAP 14.6% vs 7.6% por un cargo neto de US$958 millones de la ley OBBBA (remedición de impuestos diferidos), excluido del No-GAAP.
tax_provision.src: release income statement footnote 2; reconciliation footnote 5; Appendix A

net_income_common.en: GAAP flat at $2.9bn (-4% cc) as the OBBBA tax charge offset operating growth; non-GAAP net income +8% to $4.3bn (6% cc).
net_income_common.es: GAAP sin cambio en US$2.9 mil millones (-4% cc): el cargo fiscal OBBBA anuló el crecimiento operativo; No-GAAP +8% a US$4.3 mil millones (6% cc).

diluted_eps.en: GAAP $1.01, down 2% (tax charge plus diluted shares +2% to 2,909m); non-GAAP $1.47, up 6% USD and 4% cc.
diluted_eps.es: GAAP US$1.01, -2% (cargo fiscal y 2% más acciones diluidas, 2,909 millones); No-GAAP US$1.47, +6% en USD y +4% cc.

rpo.en: $455bn, up 359%, after "four multi-billion-dollar contracts with three different customers" (Catz); she expects RPO to exceed half a trillion within months.
rpo.es: US$455 mil millones, +359%, tras cuatro contratos multimillonarios con tres clientes distintos (Catz); espera que las RPO superen el medio billón de dólares en meses.
rpo.src: release p.1 Catz quote; transcript p.3-4 (Catz)

operating_cash_flow.en: Up 10% to $8.1bn, helped by a $2.55bn seasonal rise in deferred revenue; trailing-twelve-month OCF $21.5bn, up 13%.
operating_cash_flow.es: Subió 10% a US$8.1 mil millones, apoyado por un alza estacional de US$2,550 millones en ingresos diferidos; flujo operativo de doce meses US$21.5 mil millones, +13%.
operating_cash_flow.src: release cash-flow statement; free-cash-flow table; p.1 narrative

capex.en: $8.5bn vs $2.3bn a year ago, turning free cash flow to -$362m; Catz raised FY26 capex to "around $35 billion", mostly "revenue-generating equipment".
capex.es: US$8.5 mil millones vs US$2.3 hace un año; flujo libre -US$362 millones; Catz elevó el capex AF26 a ~US$35 mil millones, sobre todo equipo generador de ingresos.
capex.src: release cash-flow statement; free-cash-flow table; transcript p.4 (Catz)

en: Revenue $14.9bn, up 12%; Cloud +28% with Cloud Infrastructure +55%; Software down 1%.
Non-GAAP operating income +9% to $6.2bn; margin 42% vs 43% as datacenter costs ramp ahead of revenue.
Non-GAAP EPS $1.47 (+6%); GAAP EPS $1.01 (-2%) after the $958m OBBBA tax charge.
es: Ingresos US$14.9 mil millones, +12%; Nube +28%, Infraestructura +55%; Software -1%.
Utilidad operativa No-GAAP +9% a US$6.2 mil millones; margen 42% vs 43%: costos de centros de datos crecen antes que los ingresos.
UPA No-GAAP US$1.47 (+6%); UPA GAAP US$1.01 (-2%) tras el cargo fiscal OBBBA de US$958 millones.

en: Q2 FY26 (call): revenue +12-14% cc, cloud +32-36% cc, non-GAAP EPS $1.58-1.62 cc ($1.61-1.65 USD).
FY26: 16% cc revenue growth reaffirmed; OCI to grow 77% to $18bn; capex around $35bn.
OCI path $32bn, $73bn, $114bn, $144bn over FY27-FY30; detail promised at October Analyst Meeting.
es: 2T AF26 (llamada): ingresos +12-14% cc, nube +32-36% cc, UPA No-GAAP US$1.58-1.62 cc (US$1.61-1.65 USD).
AF26: se reafirma crecimiento de ingresos de 16% cc; OCI crecería 77% a US$18 mil millones; capex cercano a US$35 mil millones.
Ruta OCI de US$32, 73, 114 y 144 mil millones en AF27-AF30; detalle prometido para la Reunión de Analistas de octubre.

en: Total debt $91.3bn (vs $92.6bn at May 31) against cash and investments of $11.0bn.
Interest expense up 10% to $923m; net financing inflow only $210m this quarter.
Ellison: as a very large buyer Oracle gets "better financing terms from the vendors".
es: Deuda total US$91.3 mil millones (vs US$92.6 mil millones al 31 de mayo) frente a efectivo e inversiones de US$11.0 mil millones.
Gasto por intereses +10% a US$923 millones; el financiamiento neto del trimestre fue de apenas US$210 millones.
Ellison: por su tamaño como comprador, Oracle obtiene mejores condiciones de financiamiento de sus proveedores.

en: Capex of ~$35bn for FY26 versus $21.5bn trailing operating cash flow: funding needs will rise.
Cloud and software costs +39% against revenue +12%; watch gross margin as new capacity fills.
Software license -12%: the on-premise line keeps shrinking as customers move to cloud.
es: Capex de ~US$35 mil millones en AF26 frente a US$21.5 de flujo operativo de doce meses: subirán las necesidades de fondeo.
Costos de nube y software +39% frente a ingresos +12%; vigilar el margen bruto conforme se llena la nueva capacidad.
Licencias de software -12%: la línea en sitio sigue encogiéndose mientras los clientes migran a la nube.

en: Q2 FY27: revenue +30-34%, cloud +64-70% cc (65-71% USD), non-GAAP EPS $1.85-1.93 USD (+21-25% ex-Ampere gain).
FY27 raised: revenue at least $90bn (+34%) and non-GAAP EPS $8.10; capex $90-95bn, net cash capex at most $70bn.

AF27 al alza: ingresos de al menos US$90 mil millones (+34%) y UPA No-GAAP US$8.10; capex US$90-95, neto hasta US$70.
Cerca de la mitad de las RPO se convertiría en ingresos en 36 meses; contratos nuevos del 1T impactan desde AF28 (Maxson).

en: Completed the $20bn at-the-market equity issuance in Q1 ($19.9bn net); stockholders' equity rose to $67.2bn.
Total debt $125.3bn after $4.2bn of repayments; cash and investments $37.1bn; interest expense +55% to $1.43bn.
New AI contracts structured as prepay or bring-your-own-hardware: "no incremental impact on its plans to raise capital".

Deuda total US$125.3 mil millones tras pagar US$4.2; efectivo e inversiones US$37.1; gasto por intereses +55% a US$1,428 millones.
Los nuevos contratos de IA son prepagados o con hardware del cliente: sin impacto incremental en el plan de levantamiento de capital.

en: Operating cash flow of $23.1bn includes $11.4bn of customer prepayments: a timing benefit, not recurring operating cash.
Cloud and software costs +77% vs revenue +30%; GPU renewals at a 20% premium and 97.9% utilization support pricing (Magouyrk).
Q2 EPS will screen down 14-18% YoY against the Ampere-gain quarter (footnote 1); underlying growth guided at 21-25%.
es: El flujo operativo de US$23.1 mil millones incluye US$11.4 de prepagos de clientes: beneficio de calendario, no efectivo recurrente.
Costos de nube y software +77% vs ingresos +30%; renovaciones de GPU con prima de 20% y utilización 97.9% sostienen precios (Magouyrk).
La UPA del 2T caerá 14-18% interanual frente al trimestre de la ganancia de Ampere (nota 1); crecimiento subyacente guiado en 21-25%.

FY2027Q1.headline_en: Revenue +30% to a record $19.3bn as cloud infrastructure more than doubles; $20bn ATM completed and FY27 raised to at least $90bn.

_raw_comments_b.json.method: One comment per income-statement line and per key cash-flow/RPO item for FY2026Q1-FY2027Q1. Year-over-year = same fiscal quarter one year earlier, on Oracle's FY2026 revenue captions (Cloud / Software / Hardware / Services), using the prior-year comparative column printed in each release. Drivers are taken only from the Exhibit 99.1 press release narrative, footnotes, income-statement, cash-flow and supplemental revenue tables, and from the call quotes already extracted in transcripts.json (cited as 'transcript p.N (speaker)'). Percentages are the ones Oracle prints; where Oracle prints none, the change is computed from the two figures in quarters.json and labelled as such. Verbatim management quotes are 12 words or fewer and in double quotes. Where neither source explains a line, the comment states the change and says 'no driver given by management' / 'la administracion no da una explicacion'.
_raw_comments_b.json.caveats: Comments are ≤28 words and exec bullets ≤22 words, so they compress; the release and transcript remain the reference. Spanish is idiomatic Mexican business Spanish, not a literal translation. Guidance bullets for FY2026Q1 and FY2026Q2 come from the CFO's prepared remarks on the call because those releases printed no quantified guidance; from FY2026Q3 the release itself carries guidance. Restructuring_and_other combines Oracle's 'Restructuring' and 'Acquisition related and other' lines for Q1-Q3 FY2026 and is the single 'Restructuring and other' line from Q4 FY2026 (whose definition now also covers asset impairments). Discrete Q2-Q4 cash-flow figures are derived from cumulative statements as documented in quarters.json. Amounts in USD; 'bn' = billion (miles de millones), 'm' = million.

_raw_comments_a.json.method: Comments drafted line by line from Oracle's own Exhibit 99.1 press releases (narrative and executive quotes, condensed statement of operations with printed YoY % in USD and constant currency, non-GAAP reconciliation and its footnotes on stock-based compensation by line, amortization schedule and tax rates, balance sheet, cash flow statement, trailing FCF table, Revenues by Offerings) plus the earnings-call excerpts already extracted in transcripts.json (calls.FY2025Q1 through FY2025Q4). YoY percentages are the ones Oracle printed; no percentage was computed here. Where a result is compared with guidance, the range comes from the prior quarter's call as recorded in transcripts.json. Quarterly operating cash flow and capex for Q2-Q4 are the derived discrete figures in quarters.json (cumulative minus prior cumulative) and are labeled 'derived'; cumulative and trailing-twelve-month figures are as printed. Comments are capped at 28 words, exec-summary bullets at 22, and management quotes at 12 words. Spanish is written as natural Mexican business Spanish (mdd = millones de dólares; 'mil millones de dólares' for billions; AF = año fiscal; UPA = utilidad por acción; pb = puntos base).
_raw_comments_a.json.caveats: (1) Oracle's FY2025 releases give no line-level explanation for hardware, services, sales and marketing, R&D, G&A, tax, interest or non-operating items; those comments state the printed change, add only related facts printed in the release (stock-based compensation by line, debt issued and repaid, effective tax rates) and say no driver was given. (2) Spanish renderings of management quotes are paraphrases, not verbatim; only the English carries verbatim quotes. (3) FY2025 revenue lines use the legacy captions 'Cloud services and license support' (key cloud) and 'Cloud license and on-premise license' (key software); Oracle recast them from Q1 FY2026, so the cloud/software split is not comparable with FY2026 rows (see quarters.json revenue_recast_fy2026_basis). (4) 'Gross margin' remarks are management's spoken comments; the release prints no gross margin. (5) The FY2025Q3 non-operating comment relies on a forward-looking flag made on the Q2 call, and the FY2025Q4 one on the Q3 call's '$0.03 plus' remark taken from the transcripts.json _note rather than a quoted excerpt. (6) Guidance bullets are drawn from the calls because the FY2025 releases contain no quantified guidance table. (7) Page references in src are to the release's printed page numbers and to transcript PDF pages as recorded in transcripts.json.
